title: Run and report the first source-audited public microarray reproduction
blocked_reason: No arrays cleared the frozen donor and recent-treatment requirements. The FOSB endpoint and full matrix are pinned. See docs/research-notes/GSE51981_REPRODUCTION_STATUS_2026-11-13.md.
question: Does a preselected published endometrial expression finding reproduce under an auditable phase-aware case-versus-control limma analysis?
scope: An exploratory reproduction of published work, not independent validation or novel therapeutic discovery. Stop if audited sample mapping or reuse terms are unresolved.
steps: Freeze comparison, sample eligibility, phase handling, known result to reproduce, and exclusions before examining effects.
Explicitly opt in to official public data download and execute the existing geo-prepare and R/limma path with source-verified manifest.
Report real and negative findings, missing data, full tested family, uncertainty and competing explanations; stop on unsupported metadata.
deliverables: Reproducible methods, program versions, upstream checksums and permissible aggregate result summary.
Explicit positive, null, contradicted, or blocked outcome; raw and sample-derived data stay under ignored local paths.
acceptance: Source audit and probe annotation tasks are done before analysis.
Full source/version/exclusion and run provenance accompanies any real computation.
Reported result is preliminary computational evidence only; absence of independent replication is disclosed.
